steps.objective: File the misfiled block and copy the atlases.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text:
The archive. Shelves of paragraphs,
an aisle between each one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
Index. Archivist. You are standing in a
paragraph that the contract misfiled.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
It goes after the bibles. dap lifts the
whole paragraph, aisle and all.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
And the contract wants a copy of the atlases
by the door. yap, then P above the rail.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text:
Dot means: ip is the paragraph alone,
ap takes the blank row after it too.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
Atlases, bibles, the misfiled, and a copy
by the door. In order, for once.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Index
line.text:
The Notary signed every one of these.
He's in the vault. He'll want them back.

line.speaker: system
line.text:
Below the archive, the vault.
Someone is signing, and signing.
